Messages.Author: DenAlex
Messages.Body:
If I block a recruit War Ghoul action with Nadima and play Set's Call,
I get to keep the War Ghoul myself, but do I have to burn a retainer
or ally or the methuselah originally recruiting the ally?

Messages.Author: Daneel
Messages.Body:
On 1 Dec 2004 03:57:45 -0800, DenAlex <alexander....@pandora.be>
wrote:

> If I block a recruit War Ghoul action with Nadima and play Set's Call,
> I get to keep the War Ghoul myself, but do I have to burn a retainer
> or ally or the methuselah originally recruiting the ally?

The Methuselah who recruits the ally. So he may simply choose not to
burn an ally or retainer and the Ghoul is burned before you would get her.

--
Bye,

Daneel
